description.zh: 部署任务中对应的云产品。
description.en: The cloud service in the deployment task.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为**1**。
部署任务ID。此处ID为[CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~)返回的任务**ID**。也可通过[ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the [CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the **ID** parameter. You can also call the [ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task.

description.zh: 分页，设置每页展示的任务个数，默认50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 50.

The status of the worker task.

Valid values:

*   rollback
*   rollback_error
*   success
*   rollback_success
*   pending
*   scheduling
*   processing
*   error
*   editing

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas list-worker-resource --job-id 8888 --status editing --cloud-product NLB --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas ListWorkerResource --region cn-hangzhou --Status editing --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50 --JobId 8888 --CloudProduct NLB
